aarti.pad1: Victory to you, Mother Siddhidātrī; you are the giver of siddhi. You are the protector of devotees, the mother of your servants. The moment one takes your name, siddhi is gained; through your name the mind is made pure. ॥1॥
aarti.pad2: You accomplish hard tasks whenever you place your hand on your servant's head. In your worship there is no set rite; Jagadambā, you are the giver, you are every siddhi. ॥2॥
aarti.pad3: Whoever remembers you on Sunday, whoever holds your image alone in his mind: you bring all his work to completion, and his tasks never remain unfinished. ॥3॥
aarti.pad4: Your mercy and this māyā of yours: he over whose head the Mother keeps her shade, O giver of all siddhis, is fortunate, he who asks at your door alone, Ambā. ॥4॥
aarti.pad5: Himācala is the mountain where you dwell; you dwell in the Mahā Nandā temple. Mother, your support alone is mine; devotion is the one who asks, and you are its giver. ॥5॥
